latest_release.name: v0.1.3
latest_release.body:
## Highlights

- Split training data preparation into record-to-record, record-to-task, and task-to-batch stages (#766).
- Add OPD recipes, generated-task training, and AutoEnvScaling examples (#683, #707, #755, #790, #791).
- Let recipes choose the training method for each job (#695).
- Support Slime weight publication to vLLM through the disk transport (#710).
- Share sandbox execution through Harbor environments (#803).
- Fix interrupted training recovery, engine startup port conflicts, relative artifact work directories, and OpenRouter web-search streams (#728, #730, #723, #712, #769).

## Upgrade notes

This release changes configuration and extension interfaces.

- Use the public configuration sections. Remove `schema-version`; legacy layouts, custom service definitions, and `execution.services` are no longer accepted (#782).
- Update composite recipe components to use the `implementation`, `config`, and `runtime` recipe shape (#784).
- Update custom training stages to the three-stage pipeline. Configured plugins use a class with `from_config` (#754, #766).
- Update evaluation imports to `reef.evaluation` and shared contracts to `reef.core.evaluation` (#785).
- The legacy `reef.service.slime_driver` entry point and unused runtime APIs have been removed (#804).

See the [configuration reference](https://reefinfra.ai/docs/reference/configuration/) and [training pipeline guide](https://reefinfra.ai/docs/developer-guide/processors/) before upgrading custom deployments or recipes.

## What's Changed
* fix(service): route requests to a checkpointed release's adapter by @MikeZheng777 in https://github.com/Human-Agent-Society/reef/pull/709
* fix(artifact): publish releases with relative work directories by @YihongT in https://github.com/Human-Agent-Society/reef/pull/712
* fix: reject proposals exceeding the requires limit by @jane-jhu in https://github.com/Human-Agent-Society/reef/pull/713
* Say when a grounding document was cut short by @Kaustubh1235 in https://github.com/Human-Agent-Society/reef/pull/714
* chore(deps-dev): bump the python-minor-and-patch group with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Human-Agent-Society/reef/pull/716
* chore(deps): bump the docs-site-minor-and-patch group in /docs/site with 6 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Human-Agent-Society/reef/pull/717
* chore(deps): bump virtualenv from 21.7.12 to 21.7.13 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Human-Agent-Society/reef/pull/719
* fix(slime): honor training.timeout-s for worker RPCs by @GGQ1996 in https://github.com/Human-Agent-Society/reef/pull/715
* Publish four Guidance-TTT paper solutions and evaluation commands by @Chonghe-Jiang in https://github.com/Human-Agent-Society/reef/pull/720
* Add Yihong Tang to the contributors list by @quao627 in https://github.com/Human-Agent-Society/reef/pull/721
* docs: correct stale behavior claims in active documentation (#603) by @Yi-111-a in https://github.com/Human-Agent-Society/reef/pull/699
* docs: add ASD-STE100-inspired agent writing guidance by @BobbyZhouZijian in https://github.com/Human-Agent-Society/reef/pull/724
* feat(train): put the trainer behind the InferenceEngine contract and let Slime publish to vLLM over the disk transport by @ruizhang0101 in https://github.com/Human-Agent-Society/reef/pull/710
* refactor(harness): split adapter quirks into AdapterRenderer steps by @yanxz in https://github.com/Human-Agent-Society/reef/pull/725
* fix(inference): retry SGLang and vLLM engine startup on port conflicts by @augustuszzq in https://github.com/Human-Agent-Society/reef/pull/723
* fix(train): resume a run that never saved its optimizer, and keep its lr schedule by @MikeZheng777 in https://github.com/Human-Agent-Society/reef/pull/728
* fix(sglang): start encoder-only engines through encode_server.launch_server by @augustuszzq in https://github.com/Human-Agent-Society/reef/pull/731
* docs(operate): say what x-reef-release-id binds instead of promising a pinned version by @au
